forge.commit_provenance: supplied by the study coordinator; the binary embeds no commit hash. Its build time (2026-10-21 11:00Z) is about four minutes after that commit merged (10:56Z)
forge.binary: ccbench/bin/forge (pinned copy of the release build used for every Forge arm)

deepseek_provider: InferHub (https://api.inferhub.dev): Forge arm through its inferhub provider, Claude Code arm through InferHub's Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint

swebench.note: official swebench.harness.run_evaluation, prebuilt instance images, 4 workers

concurrency: The eight Haiku and DeepSeek arms of suites a+b+d were started within one millisecond of each other and ran side by side on this machine; the Sonnet pair ran afterwards, as a pair. In suite c the Claude Code and Forge chains ran side by side until the Claude Code chain ended; the SWE-bench and multi-turn arms of both harnesses were started together as well. The machine also hosted other agents' work, and load was not recorded, so absolute wall times carry noise.
